demand.departmentSemantics: Department is derived from the Owning Team referenced by teamId.

forecastSemantics.currentForecastRule: Complete allocations supersede Estimate amount; Estimate amount supersedes ROM amount

team.departmentSemantics: A Person belongs to one Home Team; Department is derived from that Team.

statusReport.lifecycle: Draft can be published and unpublished repeatedly. New Draft finalises the current Published report and starts the next Draft with previousReportId/previousEntries as its comparison baseline.
statusReport.draftConcurrency: Optimistic three-way merge at status-report entry field level; conflicting edits to the same field require user reconciliation.

workspace.note: workspace.department is retained only as a migration seed for pre-hierarchy workspaces.
